column1: 签证|visa|要是没有签证，我就不能去中国。|If I do not have a visa, I cannot go to China.
入学|enrol in a school|要是明天入学，我今天就去学校。|If I enrol tomorrow, I will go to the school today.
通知|notice; notify|学校有任何通知，我都会告诉你。|I will tell you about any notice from the school.
证件|identity documents|要是你没有证件，就不能进去。|If you have no identity documents, you cannot enter.
材料|materials|要是你要材料，我就给你。|If you need materials, I will give them to you.
证|certificate; card|要是学生证丢了，就去找老师。|If your student card is lost, go to the teacher.
任何|any|任何人都可以来这里学习。|Anyone can come here to study.
食堂|dining hall|要是你饿了，我们就去食堂。|If you are hungry, we will go to the dining hall.
座|measure word for buildings and mountains|要是有时间，我们就去那座山。|If we have time, we will go to that mountain.
申请|apply for|要是你想去，就先申请。|If you want to go, apply first.
奖学金|scholarship|要是有奖学金，我就不用向家里要钱。|If I have a scholarship, I will not need to ask my family for money.
表现|perform; behave|要是你表现好，老师就会很高兴。|If you do well, the teacher will be happy.
获得|obtain; win|要是认真学习，你就能获得好成绩。|If you study seriously, you can get good results.
要是|if; suppose|要是明天下雨，我就在家看书。|If it rains tomorrow, I will read at home.
减轻|reduce; lighten|要是你来帮我，就能减轻我的工作。|If you help me, you can lighten my work.
经济|economy; financial circumstances|随着经济的发展，人们的生活越来越好。|As the economy develops, people's lives get better.
压力|pressure|要是压力太大，就休息一下。|If the pressure is too great, take a break.
加油|cheer on; keep going|要是他参加比赛，我们就去给他加油。|If he enters the competition, we will cheer him on.
随着|as; along with|随着天气变冷，我穿的衣服越来越多。|As the weather gets colder, I wear more clothes.
课程|course|要是你喜欢这门课程，就来一起学吧。|If you like this course, come and study with us.
专业|major; professional|要是你喜欢中文，就选这个专业吧。|If you like Chinese, choose this major.
本科|undergraduate studies|要是读完本科，我就去工作。|If I finish my undergraduate studies, I will start work.
硕士|master's degree|要是有机会，我就去读硕士。|If I have the chance, I will study for a master's degree.
研究生|postgraduate student|要是考上研究生，我就去北京学习。|If I get into postgraduate school, I will go to Beijing to study.
博士|doctorate; PhD|要是你想读博士，就要认真准备。|If you want to study for a doctorate, you need to prepare seriously.
研究|research; study|要是有时间，我就研究这个问题。|If I have time, I will study this question.
活动|activity|要是明天有活动，我就参加。|If there is an activity tomorrow, I will join in.
通过|through; pass|要是通过考试，我就请你吃饭。|If I pass the exam, I will treat you to a meal.
交流|communicate; exchange|要是有问题，就和老师交流一下。|If you have a question, talk with the teacher.
适应|adapt to|随着时间过去，我越来越适应这里的生活。|As time passes, I adapt more and more to life here.
将来|future|要是现在认真学习，将来就有更多机会。|If you study seriously now, you will have more opportunities in the future.
国际|international|要是能去国际公司工作，我就很高兴。|If I can work at an international company, I will be happy.
当|work as; become|要是你想当老师，就要喜欢孩子。|If you want to be a teacher, you need to like children.
教育|education; educate|要是你对教育感兴趣，就来我们学校看看。|If you are interested in education, visit our school.
成为|become|要是你想成为医生，就要认真学习。|If you want to become a doctor, you need to study seriously.
教师|teacher|要是有机会，我就做一名教师。|If I have the chance, I will become a teacher.
贸易|trade|要是你想做贸易，就先学中文吧。|If you want to work in trade, study Chinese first.
方面|aspect; area|学中文一方面很有意思，另一方面也很有用。|Studying Chinese is interesting on one hand and useful on the other.
知识|knowledge|要是想学更多知识，就多看看书。|If you want to learn more, read more books.
另|another; other|我一方面想工作，另一方面也想学习。|On one hand I want to work, and on the other I want to study.
房东|landlord; landlady|有问题，问房东就是了。|If you have a question, just ask the landlord.
出租|rent out|这间房出租，不过有点儿小。|This room is for rent, but it is a little small.
房租|rent|房租不高，不过离学校远。|The rent is not high, but it is far from school.
收拾|tidy up|房间不大，不过收拾得很干净。|The room is not large, but it is very tidy.
租|rent|喜欢这个房子，租下来就是了。|If you like this home, just rent it.
嗯|mhm; yes|嗯，这里很好，不过有点儿贵。|Mhm, this place is good, but a little expensive.
亮|bright; shine|房间很亮，不过有点儿热。|The room is bright, but a little hot.
就是|just; simply (emphasis)|想去，告诉我就是了。|If you want to go, just tell me.
种|plant; grow|我想种花，不过没有时间。|I want to plant flowers, but I have no time.
周围|surroundings; around|周围很安静，不过商店不多。|The surroundings are quiet, but there are not many shops.
不过|but; however|这里很小，不过住着很舒服。|This place is small, but it is comfortable to live in.
毕业|graduate|我毕业了，不过还想在学校学习。|I have graduated, but still want to study at school.
恐怕|perhaps; I'm afraid|我很想去，不过恐怕没有时间。|I really want to go, but I am afraid I have no time.
热闹|lively; bustling|这里很热闹，不过晚上很安静。|It is lively here, but quiet at night.
入住|move in; check in|今天可以入住，不过要先给钱。|You can move in today, but you need to pay first.
日记|diary|我每天写日记，不过写得不多。|I write a diary every day, but not very much.
顺利|smooth; successful|考试很顺利，不过我还要努力。|The exam went smoothly, but I still need to work hard.
并|and; definitely (with negatives)|这个问题并不难。|This question is not actually difficult.
客厅|living room|客厅很大，不过没有电视。|The living room is large, but there is no television.
台|measure word for machines|我有一台电脑，不过有点儿旧。|I have a computer, but it is a little old.
厨房|kitchen|厨房很小，不过很干净。|The kitchen is small, but clean.
平常|usually; ordinary|平常我走路上学，不过今天坐车。|I usually walk to school, but today I am taking a vehicle.
基本上|basically; generally|我基本上都听懂了，不过还有一个问题。|I understood almost everything, but I still have a question.
整个|whole; entire|整个房子都很好，不过有点儿贵。|The whole home is good, but a little expensive.
毛巾|towel|这条毛巾很好，不过我想买白色的。|This towel is good, but I want to buy a white one.
建议|suggestion; suggest|他的建议很好，不过我还想想。|His suggestion is good, but I want to think some more.
查看|check; look over|我查看了材料，并告诉了老师。|I checked the materials and told the teacher.
信息|information; message|信息很多，不过有些没有用。|There is a lot of information, but some is not useful.
查找|look for; search|我查找了很久，不过还没找到。|I searched for a long time, but have not found it yet.
接着|then; next|我想接着学习，不过有点儿累。|I want to continue studying, but I am a little tired.
同时|at the same time; also|他学习中文，不过同时也要工作。|He studies Chinese, but also needs to work at the same time.
位置|location; position|这个位置很好，不过有点儿贵。|This location is good, but a little expensive.
价格|price|价格不高，不过东西很好。|The price is not high, but the item is good.
理想|ideal; ideal goal|这里很理想，不过离家有点儿远。|This place is ideal, but a little far from home.
由于|because of; because|由于下雨，我们没有出去。|Because of the rain, we did not go out.
工资|salary; pay|工资不高，不过我很喜欢这个工作。|The salary is not high, but I like this job.
感|feeling; sense (suffix)|这里很小，不过让我有安全感。|This place is small, but it gives me a sense of security.
十字路口|crossroads|这里大是大，不过只有一个十字路口。|This place is big, but there is only one crossroads.
直接|direct; directly|我不仅可以坐车，还可以直接走过去。|I can take a vehicle, or I can walk straight there.
转|turn; change|我找不到路，于是向右转了。|I could not find the way, so I turned right.
正好|just right; happen to|我想找他，他正好也来了，于是我们一起吃饭。|I wanted to find him and he happened to arrive, so we ate together.
熟悉|be familiar with|我不仅熟悉这里，还认识很多人。|I am familiar with this place and also know many people.
正|due; straight (direction)|这里不仅在学校的正南边，还离家很近。|This place is due south of the school and also close to home.
目的地|destination|我不认识路，于是问他怎么去目的地。|I did not know the way, so I asked him how to reach the destination.
下载|download|我想听音乐，于是下载了这首歌。|I wanted to listen to music, so I downloaded this song.
进行|carry out; conduct|我们不仅进行交流，还一起学习。|We communicate and also study together.
支付|pay|我不仅用手机支付，还用手机学习。|I pay with my phone and also use it to study.
软件|software|这个软件好是好，不过我不会用。|This software is good, but I do not know how to use it.
不仅|not only|他不仅会说中文，还会写汉字。|He can speak Chinese and also write Chinese characters.
扫码|scan a code|我不会扫码，于是请他帮忙。|I did not know how to scan the code, so I asked him for help.
结账|settle the bill|吃完饭了，于是我们去结账。|We finished eating, so we went to pay the bill.
购物|shop|我不仅在网上购物，还在网上学习。|I shop online and also study online.
订|order; book|我想去北京，于是订了票。|I wanted to go to Beijing, so I booked a ticket.
快递|express delivery|快递快是快，不过有点儿贵。|Express delivery is fast, but a little expensive.
现金|cash|我没有现金，于是向朋友借钱。|I had no cash, so I borrowed money from a friend.
网购|shop online|网购不仅方便，而且很快。|Online shopping is convenient and fast.
寄|send; mail|我不仅寄了书，还寄了衣服。|I sent books and also clothes.
等|etc.; and so on|我买了书、笔等，甚至还买了一台电脑。|I bought books, pens and so on, and even a computer.
货|goods|货不仅多，而且价格不高。|There are many goods, and the prices are not high.
甚至|even|他很忙，甚至没有时间吃饭。|He is very busy and does not even have time to eat.
改变|change|天气变了，于是我改变了出发时间。|The weather changed, so I changed the departure time.
手指|finger|手指疼，于是我不写了。|My finger hurt, so I stopped writing.
乱|randomly; messy|房间乱是乱，不过东西都能找到。|The room is messy, but everything can be found.
管|control; manage|他不仅管自己，还管弟弟。|He manages himself and also his younger brother.
提供|provide|学校不仅提供书，还提供电脑。|The school provides books and also computers.
身份证|identity card|我没带身份证，于是回家拿了。|I did not bring my ID card, so I went home to get it.
个人|individual; personal|我不仅写了姓名，还写了其他个人信息。|I wrote my name and also other personal information.
能否|whether or not (can)|我不知道能否参加，于是问了老师。|I did not know whether I could join, so I asked the teacher.
保护|protect|我们不仅要保护自己，还要帮助别人。|We need to protect ourselves and also help others.
于是|so; thereupon|我饿了，于是去食堂吃饭。|I was hungry, so I went to eat at the dining hall.
密码|password|我忘了密码，于是不能用电脑了。|I forgot the password, so I could not use the computer.
随便|casually; as one likes|我不知道吃什么，于是随便买了一点儿。|I did not know what to eat, so I bought something without much thought.
技术|technology; technique|他不仅学习技术，还研究中国文化。|He studies technology and also researches Chinese culture.
法律|law|我不仅学习中文，还学习中国法律。|I study Chinese and also Chinese law.
手段|means; method|他不仅有新的手段，还有很多好方法。|He has new means and also many good methods.
保证|guarantee; ensure|我不仅保证早点儿来，还会认真准备。|I promise to come early and also prepare carefully.
网络|network; internet|网络不仅方便，还让我们有更多交流。|The internet is convenient and also lets us communicate more.
啊|ah; oh|啊，太晚了，来不及了！|Oh, it is too late; there is not enough time!
停|stop; park|这里停不了车，再去前面看看吧。|We cannot park here; let's look further ahead.
交|hand over; pay|我现在交不了钱，明天再来吧。|I cannot pay now; let's come back tomorrow.
费|fee; cost|这里的费用既不高，服务又好。|The fees here are not high, and the service is good.
信号|signal|这里没有信号，上不了网。|There is no signal here, so I cannot get online.
感谢|thank; be grateful|来得及的话，我想去感谢他。|If there is enough time, I want to go and thank him.
联系|contact|我联系不了他，你帮我打个电话吧。|I cannot reach him; please help me call him.
方式|way; method|这种方式既快又方便。|This way is fast and convenient.
客气|polite; courteous|别客气，再说我们是朋友。|Do not be so polite; besides, we are friends.
剩|remain; be left|剩下的饭太多，我吃不了。|There is too much food left; I cannot eat it all.
提|carry in one's hand|这个东西太大，我提不了。|This thing is too big; I cannot carry it.
袋子|bag|这个袋子既大又好看。|This bag is large and attractive.
重|heavy; weight|这个太重了，我拿不了。|This is too heavy; I cannot carry it.
算|count; consider as|我算不了这么快，你慢点儿说。|I cannot calculate so fast; speak more slowly.
再说|besides; furthermore|今天太晚了，再说我也累了。|It is too late today, and besides, I am tired.
之间|between|我们之间既是朋友，也是同学。|We are friends as well as classmates.
互相|each other; mutually|我们既互相学习，也互相帮助。|We learn from and also help each other.
辛苦|hard; laborious|你既要工作，又要学习，真辛苦。|You work and study; that is really hard.
出行|travel; go out|出行既可以坐车，也可以走路。|You can travel by vehicle or on foot.
距离|distance|距离太远，我走不了那么久。|The distance is too great; I cannot walk for that long.
往往|often; tend to|我往往来不及吃早饭。|I often do not have time to eat breakfast.
既|both; as well as|这里既安静又干净。|This place is both quiet and clean.
电动车|electric bike|电动车既快又方便。|An electric bike is fast and convenient.
速度|speed|这个速度既快又安全。|This speed is both fast and safe.
充电|charge a battery|这里可以充电，再说离家也近。|You can charge here, and besides, it is close to home.
流行|be popular|这种衣服既流行又便宜。|These clothes are popular and inexpensive.
省|save|骑车既省钱，又能锻炼身体。|Cycling saves money and also gives you exercise.
力气|physical strength|我没有力气，拿不了这些书。|I have no strength; I cannot carry these books.
乘客|passenger|乘客太多，我上不了车。|There are too many passengers; I cannot get on.
购买|buy; purchase|来得及的话，我们去购买一些书。|If there is enough time, we will go and buy some books.
食物|food|这些食物既好吃又便宜。|This food is delicious and inexpensive.
免费|free of charge|这里既免费，又能学到知识。|This place is free, and you can learn things here.
早餐|breakfast|我来不及吃早餐了。|I do not have time to eat breakfast.
来得及|have enough time|现在出发，还来得及。|If we leave now, there is still enough time.
鲜花|fresh flowers|这些鲜花既好看又便宜。|These flowers are pretty and inexpensive.
顺便|in passing; conveniently|来得及的话，我顺便去买菜。|If there is enough time, I will buy some vegetables on the way.
心情|mood|心情不好时，我既不想说话，也不想出门。|When I am in a bad mood, I want neither to talk nor to go out.
更加|even more|这里既更加安静，也更加方便。|This place is both quieter and more convenient.
愉快|pleasant; happy|这次活动既有意思，又让人愉快。|This activity is interesting and enjoyable.
至少|at least|我每天至少学一个小时中文。|I study Chinese for at least an hour every day.
中餐|Chinese food|我每周至少吃三次中餐。|I eat Chinese food at least three times a week.
专门|specially; on purpose|我专门为你做的菜，够好吃的吧？|The dish I made specially for you is really tasty, isn't it?
煮|boil; cook|这个要至少煮十分钟。|This needs to cook for at least ten minutes.
油|oil|这些油够用了。|There is enough oil to use.
道|measure word for dishes|我们至少要三道菜。|We need at least three dishes.
熟|cooked; familiar|等饭熟了再吃。|Wait until the food is cooked before eating.
倒|pour|等水不热了，再倒进去。|Wait until the water is not hot, then pour it in.
辣椒|chili pepper|这些辣椒够多的。|There are really a lot of chilies.
辣|spicy|这个菜够辣的。|This dish is really spicy.
敢|dare|等你来了，我才敢进去。|I will only dare to go in after you arrive.
肚子|belly; abdomen|等肚子不疼了，再去吃饭。|Wait until your stomach stops hurting, then go and eat.
相同|same; identical|我们至少有一个相同的爱好。|We have at least one hobby in common.
顺序|order; sequence|至少要先了解顺序。|At least we need to understand the order first.
够|enough; really|这些东西够我们吃了。|These things are enough for us to eat.
不够|not enough|这些钱不够买一台电脑。|This money is not enough to buy a computer.
达到|reach; achieve|等达到这个水平，再学下一课。|Wait until you reach this level, then study the next lesson.
聚|gather; get together|我们每个月至少聚一次。|We get together at least once a month.
午餐|lunch|等你来了，我们再吃午餐。|We will eat lunch after you arrive.
咸|salty|这个菜够咸的。|This dish is really salty.
凉|cool; cold|等水凉了再喝。|Wait until the water cools before drinking.
酸|sour|这个苹果够酸的。|This apple is really sour.
汤|soup|这些汤够我们喝了。|There is enough soup for us.
各|each|我们各吃各的饭。|We each eat our own meal.
付|pay|这次我们各付各的钱。|This time we each pay for ourselves.
聚餐|dine together|等大家都有时间了再聚餐。|Wait until everyone has time before dining together.
随意|casual; as one likes|他说话够随意的。|He speaks very casually.
正式|formal; official|等大家来了，活动再正式开始。|Wait until everyone arrives before formally starting the activity.
普通|ordinary; common|这是一家够普通的商店。|This is a very ordinary shop.
重视|attach importance to|学校至少应该重视学生的问题。|Schools should at least take students’ problems seriously.
座位|seat|这里至少有十个座位。|There are at least ten seats here.
安排|arrange; arrangements|等你来了，我们再安排。|We will make arrangements after you arrive.
按照|according to|至少要按照老师说的做。|At least follow what the teacher said.
年龄|age|等到了这个年龄，你就知道了。|When you reach this age, you will understand.
面对|face; confront|至少要学会面对问题。|At least learn to face problems.
主人|host; owner|等主人坐下，我们再坐。|Wait until the host sits down, then we will sit.
等|wait until; till|等他来了，我们再走。|We will leave after he arrives.
尊重|respect|我们至少应该尊重别人的选择。|We should at least respect other people's choices.
咳嗽|cough|他咳嗽得很厉害。|He is coughing badly.
咳|cough|他偶尔咳几声。|He coughs a few times occasionally.
厉害|severe; intense|今天头疼得很厉害。|My head hurts badly today.
严重|serious; severe|我偶尔生病，不过不严重。|I occasionally get ill, but it is not serious.
赶快|quickly; at once|赶快回家，好早点儿休息。|Go home quickly so you can rest earlier.
陪|accompany|我偶尔陪妈妈去买菜。|I occasionally go shopping for vegetables with my mother.
翻译|translate; interpreter|我来翻译，好让你听懂。|I will translate so you can understand.
护士|nurse|我偶尔和那位护士聊天儿。|I occasionally chat with that nurse.
表|form; table|先写这张表，好早点儿办完。|Fill in this form first so we can finish earlier.
性别|gender; sex|先写性别，好让老师了解你。|Write your gender first so the teacher can learn about you.
国籍|nationality|我偶尔会问朋友的国籍。|I occasionally ask my friends their nationality.
家庭|family|我偶尔介绍自己的家庭。|I occasionally introduce my family.
地址|address|告诉我地址，好去找你。|Tell me the address so I can find you.
挂号|register (at a hospital)|早点儿挂号，好早点儿看病。|Register early so you can see the doctor earlier.
排队|line up; queue|大家排队，好一个一个进去。|Everyone line up so we can enter one by one.
